excerpt: The building consists of a cylindrical concrete shell of 60 m diameter and 40 m height (inner shell). The centre of the raft supports a concrete cylinder 7 m in diameter, 2 m thick and 15 m in height. This cylinder is the core of the reactor.
publisher: IGORR (International Group on Research Reactors), 10th meeting; authors at Institut Laue-Langevin and Areva
title: Seismic strengthening of the ILL High Flux Reactor building (IGORR 10, L. Germane, J.-M. Thiry, F. Plewinski)
